mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, we are seeing clear skies near the Verona Area High School under a full moon. Keep your eyes on the skies at 5:01 PM tonight as the International Space Station will be visible for five minutes, rising from the northwest near the high school and moving toward the northeast near Home Depot.

City Hall reminds residents that municipal buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving. Additionally, refuse and recycling collection will be delayed to Friday, November 27, and the recycling center will be closed during the holiday.
There is a great lineup of local entertainment this week, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run, followed by yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness.

In a report covering November 1 through 15, on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a woman passed out in her vehicle and subsequently arrested her for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Overload. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
